---
title: "Nova on Start + Void"
description: "Nova Worker configuration, the tuturuuu.com/nova mount, root-host redirects, smoke probes and Worker-version rollback."
updatedAt: "2026-11-21"
audience: developers
---

Nova (`apps/nova`) has native TanStack Start + Vite+ + Void source using
`@tuturuuu/start-bridge`. The production Worker `tuturuuu-nova` serves
`tuturuuu.com/nova`: the gateway mounts `/nova` and `/nova/*` through
`MOUNT_NOVA`, committed in `apps/gateway/wrangler.jsonc`. The root hosts
`nova.ai.vn` and `nova.tuturuuu.com` are custom domains on small redirect
Workers (`site-nova-redirect` in the account that holds the `nova.ai.vn` zone,
`tuturuuu-nova-redirect` in the Tuturuuu account). Each answers `307` to
`https://tuturuuu.com/nova` with path and query preserved, as the production
profile does for root hosts.

## Worker configuration

- Staging Worker: the staging Worker name (`VITE_NOVA_NATIVE_PROFILE=staging`).
- Production Worker: `tuturuuu-nova` (`VITE_NOVA_NATIVE_PROFILE=production`).
- Hosts: `nova.tuturuuu.com`, `nova.ai.vn`, and `nova.tutur3u.com`.
- The Worker config declares the `ASSETS` static asset binding. Runtime
  Runtime names include `TUTURUUU_APP_COORDINATION_SECRET`,
  `SUPABASE_SECRET_KEY`, `NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL`, and
  `NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY`. Abuse guard uses service binding
  `ABUSE_GUARD` (`tuturuuu-abuse-guard`), secret `ABUSE_GUARD_KEY_PEPPER`,
  `ABUSE_GUARD_FAMILIES`, and optional `ABUSE_GUARD_TIMEOUT_MS`.
  Upstash credentials are no longer required. The abuse guard is optional, as on Vercel: with none of `ABUSE_GUARD_KEY_PEPPER`, `ABUSE_GUARD_FAMILIES` and the Upstash names set, the Worker skips the guard and logs the names once per isolate. Setting any of them requires a complete configuration, and the Worker refuses to serve otherwise. This packet records names only.
- `TUTURUUU_NOINDEX` is `1` in staging and `0` in production.
- Build from the app directory with `bun run build:cloudflare`. If workspace
  outputs are missing, run `bun turbo:local run build --filter='@tuturuuu/nova^...' --concurrency=2` first.

Before sealing, record the serving Worker's `ABUSE_GUARD_FAMILIES` in the
repository variable `NOVA_ABUSE_GUARD_FAMILIES`. The `nova-cutover-artifact`
job preserves that value in the emitted config and rejects a missing or
unknown family. The Workerd acceptance uses the sealed family list, a synthetic
service binding and pepper, and no Upstash bindings. The archive uploads only after
the sealed output and a fresh restore both pass workerd acceptance on the
subdomain and apex profiles. Hosted staging and private upload remain separate
release gates.

## Smoke probes

After Rex enables a candidate route, check each host and the public build identity:

```bash
for host in nova.tuturuuu.com nova.ai.vn nova.tutur3u.com; do
  curl -sSI "https://$host/"
  curl -sS "https://$host/api/build-info"
done
curl -sSI 'https://tuturuuu.com/nova?source=smoke'
curl -sS https://tuturuuu.com/nova/api/build-info
```

Confirm the root hosts serve Nova, `/nova` works on `tuturuuu.com`, build-info
reports the expected commit, and responses carry the intended cache and
indexing policy. Probe only after the route owner provides the candidate URL or
has authorized the host route.

## Rollback

Rollback is the recorded previous Cloudflare version: `tuturuuu-nova` for an app
regression, `tuturuuu-gateway` for a mount regression, and the redirect Worker
for a root-host regression. Never move a host back to Vercel, rebuild, or change
application data during rollback; fix forward on Cloudflare. The Vercel project
is an archived record only.

## Local verification

Run `bun run build:cloudflare` from `apps/nova`. Runtime qualification is
`CI=true CI_SOURCE_SHA=$(git rev-parse HEAD) bun run test:runtime`. The local
runtime command currently fails under Node 22 because its `.mjs` suites import
TypeScript config modules directly (`ERR_UNKNOWN_FILE_EXTENSION`); preserve the
failure in the cutover evidence and require the CI runtime result before any
route change.
